parameters.description: Optional name of a measured run (the token bench): stored with every model call of this turn in llm_calls, read back with GET /api/usage/runs. 1-64 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ . - (not . or ..); anything else is 422 invalid_args.

200.description: SSE conversation. The questions event carries ask_id and 1-4 questions with id, text, options, allow_other and multiple. A workflow Run form includes workflow_preview with summary and ordered steps (title, tool). Reply with a message and optional answers. The plan event carries plan_id and steps with id, title, status and optional evidence_id. A saved workflow adds its name as plan.workflow. The host builds its next spec from recorded results. A spec using an assistant-set selection includes assistant_selection with tool, count and a bounded list of ids. A card targeting a large current selection includes selection_reference with its count, categories, stamp and document_id. The mentions event reports omitted automatic picks by reason in current_selection.omitted. ask_selection starts a selection watch in the active page. Reply with selection_answer and mentions. view_image carries the capture_id, PNG, view name and dimensions. capture_context reports per-image visibility; image_notice explains disabled image input. missing_tool offers local navigation choices. A new planner stage can propose the next step in the same stream.

get.description:
Items the designer can pick in chat: the package's
``mention_candidates`` reply as it is - ``{kind, items: [{kind, id, name, label, detail,
category?, family?, disabled?, reason?, summary?, level?, category_label?, document_id?}], total, truncated,
offset, facets, category_matched, facets_partial?, warnings?, source?, selected?}``. An empty type query offers categories. A type search offers matching types;
element lists the current selection with a summary, level, category label and document identity, or - when
nothing is selected - the matching elements of the whole model; ``source`` says which (``selection`` /
``model``) and ``selected`` how many elements are selected. When
facets_partial is true the category counts cover only the rows read. A disconnected link is disabled. A
kind or category the package refuses is 422 (``unknown_kind``, ``invalid_args``); Revit
reporting an error is 200 with the package's ``error``, as on ``/query``; no Revit to ask
is 503 ``revit_unreachable``. The same device rules as every route here.

post.description:

message is sent: the package's ``resolve_sketch`` reply - ``{view_name, view_type, view_kind, level,

post.description:
``validate_spec`` + ``Gate.issue(channel="host_ui")``: the designer confirmed the card.
Returns ``{token, spec_hash, expires_at, card}``; an invalid spec is 422 ``{errors}`` -
a parameter bound to a pick that is not one verified in the chat session ``session_id``
for this device (or not bound as that pick is) among them, code ``unknown_mention``. A
spec that binds picks has them read again from the open model first (``recheck_picks``):
one gone, renamed, or changed in element category, family or type name since selection is ``unknown_mention`` too; no Revit to ask is 503
``revit_unreachable`` (503 ``revit_error``, 504 ``revit_timeout``). A spec without picks
needs no Revit here unless it uses a selection reference. The host checks its document and stamp
before issuing a token and returns 409 selection_changed if they differ. The token belongs to the browser session and never enters the model
context.

post.description:
``checking.check_code``: compile the snippet in Revit without running it - no token,
nothing changes. The package's reply as it is (``{schema_version, checked, compiled,
blocked, capability, reason, diagnostics, truncated, fingerprint, hints, guidance,
environment, warnings}``), with the guidance lessons the MCP tool adds. ``pack`` +
``values`` instead of ``code``: the draft's template filled by the package first (422
``invalid_pack`` / ``render_failed``). A draft diagnostic can also carry ``template_column``
to locate it before substitution. As the MCP tool does, code the sandbox refuses is
answered before Revit is needed (``blocked: true``); no Revit to ask is 503
``revit_unreachable``, as on every route. On a cloud host 429 ``rate_limited`` past
``/spec/confirm``'s limit.

post.description:
``dry_run.dry_run_code``: run the snippet in the open model inside a transaction group
the add-in always rolls back - nothing is kept, the undo stack is untouched, so no
confirmation and no token (the package's rule: the gate takes no part in a dry run).
The package's reply as it is (``{success, rolled_back, result, error, diagnostics,
changes, failures, fingerprint, evidence_id, hint, warnings}``); each request that
reaches the add-in leaves a ``dry_run`` line in the evidence ledger of this device's
scope. Draft diagnostics may include the original ``template_column``.
``pack`` + ``values`` instead of ``code``: the draft's template filled by the
package first, exactly the code the saved pack would send. Code the sandbox refuses is
answered before Revit is needed (``error: "blocked"``); no Revit to ask is 503
``revit_unreachable``. On a cloud host 429 ``rate_limited`` past ``/spec/confirm``'s
limit.

post.description:
``DeviceStore.redeem``: the add-in turns the code into its device token.

Called by the add-in or its installer, so it carries no device headers -
the code is the credential. Unknown, expired, already used: all
``invalid_code``, with no hint which.

422.description: Body or query parsed but not valid (invalid_args, invalid_spec, invalid_snapshot, invalid_pack)

429.description: Too many requests from this address (rate_limited)

503.description: The device store could not be read for a moment; nothing changed, try again (device_store_unavailable)

get.description: Every device, for an operator holding the admin password.

403.description: Slot header missing or wrong (missing_slot, invalid_slot_token)

get.description: One device: is it online, when was it last seen, how many requests has it served.

403.description: Slot header missing or wrong (missing_slot, invalid_slot_token)

422.description: Body or query parsed but not valid (invalid_args, invalid_spec, invalid_snapshot, invalid_pack)

delete.description: Revoke the device and close its socket: no more requests, key and token dead.

403.description: Slot header missing or wrong (missing_slot, invalid_slot_token)

422.description: Body or query parsed but not valid (invalid_args, invalid_spec, invalid_snapshot, invalid_pack)

503.description: The device store could not be read for a moment; nothing changed, try again (device_store_unavailable). If MCP token cleanup fails after revocation, the device is already revoked (token_store_unavailable).

get.description:
Runtime configuration for the SPA (read once at startup). ``features.chatModes``
lists the chat modes the caller may pick: on a cloud host every mode only with the
right ``X-Admin-Token``, else ``auto`` alone.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The chat mode the request ran in: single, roles or roles_analyst (null for a call recorded before modes were).

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: Document identity recorded by the element picker

label.title: Label
label.description: what the page showed; not sent to the model

ChatMention.title: ChatMention
ChatMention.description:
A model item the designer picked in the message (``@level``, ``@type``, ``@link``, ``@element``), as
``GET /api/v1/bridge/mentions`` listed it. Only ``kind`` and ``id`` are checked and used:
the model gets the item as the package reads it from Revit now, never the page's
``label``.

sketch.description: Lines the designer drew on a view capture, with a designer-typed bridge message.

current_selection.description: Selection observed with a designer-typed bridge message. The host verifies IDs or attaches a stamped reference above the combined 20-pick limit.

selection_answer.title: Selection Answer
selection_answer.description: ask_id answered by document-scoped element mentions

hidden_captures.title: Hidden Captures
hidden_captures.description: Exclude these session captures from planner context

mentions.title: Mentions
mentions.description: The designer's picks in this message (with message and the bridge only), checked against the open model before the model is called: the event mentions reports each, and the verified ones reach the model as the package's selections block.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: How the chat runs this request: single (one model loop), roles (planner + supervisor), roles_analyst (analyst + planner + supervisor), or auto (absent or null too): the host's default, /config.json features.chatModeDefault. A local host honours it; a cloud host only with the right X-Admin-Token, else it runs the default. Without the bridge the request runs as single. The mode run is on the turn's first stage event.

image.title: Image
image.description: base64 PNG: the capture with the designer's lines on it

ChatSketch.title: ChatSketch
ChatSketch.description:
Lines the designer drew on a view capture from ``POST /api/v1/bridge/sketch/capture``. The
host converts the strokes to model coordinates with the frame it kept for that capture and
appends them to the message as text; ``image`` (the capture with the lines drawn on it, a PNG
of the capture's size) is shown to a planner that takes images, and to nothing else.

ChoicesRequest.title: ChoicesRequest
ChoicesRequest.description:
One ``choices_from`` of the pack format: levels | floor_types | family_types:OST_* |
elements | elements:OST_*.

selection_reference.description: Observed selection identity on this chat card

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: The chat session the spec comes from (the X-Session-Id of /api/chat): a parameter bound to a pick (evidence mention:<kind>#<id>) must be one the designer made and the package verified in that session. Without it no such binding is accepted.

compiled.title: Compiled
compiled.description: Automatic sample compile result; null if unavailable.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Compiler diagnostics for the returned draft.

ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody
ErrorBody.description:
What every non-2xx bridge response carries (further fields depend on the code:
``hint``, ``problems``, ``errors``, ``warnings``, ``kind``, ``tool``, ``endpoint``...).

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: The chat session the spec comes from (the X-Session-Id of /api/chat): a parameter bound to a pick (evidence mention:<kind>#<id>) must be one the designer made and the package verified in that session. Without it no such binding is accepted.

RolePart.title: RolePart
RolePart.description:
The calls of one role with one model within a run: each token sum is null when any
of those calls lacks it.

by_role.title: By Role
by_role.description: The same sums per role and model of the run, in the order of their first call.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The chat mode the run's calls ran in (single, roles, roles_analyst); mixed when they ran in more than one; null when none was recorded.

RunTotal.title: RunTotal
RunTotal.description: The calls of one run label: each token sum is null when any call lacks it.

SketchStrokes.title: SketchStrokes
SketchStrokes.description:
What the designer drew on a capture from ``POST /sketch/capture``: each stroke the
``[x, y]`` pixels of the capture it passes, in the order drawn, at most 600 points.
